approved: Income Tax Amendment (Labour Mobility Program) Bill 2022

The Income Tax Amendment (Labour Mobility Program) Bill 2022 ensures foreign resident workers under the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme pay a final withholding tax of 15 per cent on scheme income, broadening the definition from the old Seasonal Labour Mobility Program to cover PALM and future similar visa schemes from the 2022-23 income year.
Income Tax Amendment (Labour Mobility Program) Act 2022
